evidence.ACL: Mild laxity of ACL and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 2 injury.
evidence.MCL: The contour of MCL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of partial tear.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.PF OA: Suspicious of mild farying articular cartilage of patella, R/O grade 2 chondromalacia.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion and mild suprapatellar bursitis of right knee.
evidence.Baker's: A small lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
evidence.Contusion: Abnormal signal intensity is noted in distal femur and small area of lateral tibial condyle, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
